In node2vec, the unnormalized transition bias \(\alpha_{pq}(t,x)\) depends on the shortest-path distance between the previous node \(t\) and the candidate next node \(x\):
- \(\alpha_{pq}(t,x) = 1/p\) if \(x = t\) (the walk would immediately return to the previous node).
- \(\alpha_{pq}(t,x) = 1\) if \(x\) is adjacent to \(t\) (i.e., \(d_{tx} = 1\)).
- \(\alpha_{pq}(t,x) = 1/q\) if \(x\) is not adjacent to \(t\) (i.e., \(d_{tx} = 2\) in an unweighted, undirected graph setting used by node2vec).
